subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should this PR close as obsolete after the cron SQLite migration, or does a remaining legacy-import path still need the bounded-read hardening?
rationale: Current main has removed the runtime module changed by the PR, but the exact migration provenance and any remaining legacy importer require an owner familiar with the cron storage transition.

options.title: Close as obsolete
options.body: Confirm the SQLite migration removed all runtime quarantine-sidecar reads and close this PR without carrying the old file path forward.

options.title: Retarget legacy import
options.body: If doctor or startup migration still reads the old sidecar, move the bounded-read protection and focused tests to that importer.

recommendation.title: Close as obsolete
recommendation.body: Confirm the SQLite migration removed all runtime quarantine-sidecar reads and close this PR without carrying the old file path forward.
